# Frozen novelty statement

The publishable contribution is an integrated, explicit finite-block theorem:
on one declared four-dimensional \(SU(2)\) heat-kernel block, rooted-tree Haar
reduction, retained/fiber separation, a rational curvature floor, nonlinear
chart and heat-kernel bounds, strong conditional convexity, Wasserstein
response, and the Hessian effect of exact marginalization are joined with
machine-checkable constants.

The paper does not claim novelty for tree gauge, Hodge theory, heat-kernel
images, Brascamp--Lieb, transport inequalities, or Schur complements. Balaban's
constructive RG results are substantially stronger in multiscale reach. No
“first,” “unprecedented,” or “no prior work” language is authorized.
